Disappointing Experience at Arapang Restaurant – Choose other options
Mar 2025 • Couples
We purchased the premium dinner buffet tickets for Arapang Restaurant at the bottom of the cable car while checking into our hotel at Ba Na Hills. At the time, we were unaware that there were multiple dining options available, and unfortunately, we committed to the tickets even though they were exceptionally expensive.

The experience turned out to be the worst dining experience we had in Vietnam. The restaurant was overcrowded, mostly filled with large tour groups, and it was extremely noisy, making it hard to have any kind of relaxing meal. It was also very difficult to find seating, and the lines for food were long and poorly managed.

Despite being advertised as an international buffet, the food was not to our taste—and the variety and quality were underwhelming. The service was lacking, and overall, the atmosphere was chaotic. We truly regretted purchasing the dinner ticket and wished we had explored other dining options.

On a more positive note, breakfast the next morning was much quieter, and the food seemed better than the night before, though still not enough to make up for the dinner experience.

If you're considering dining here, I’d recommend looking into other restaurants at Ba Na Hills before deciding. For us, the premium dinner buffet at Arapang was not worth the price or the stress.

Good Buffet!
Nov 2024 • Family
After our visit on the Golden Bridge and Flower Gardens at Ba Na Hills, as it was lunch time, we came by to this restaurant for our lunch. It was buffet styled and the restaurant was huge and spacious, covering two storeys. Our cable car ticket cover the admission to Ba Na Hills and included the buffet (if you pay personally for the buffet, it was 350K dong).

The spread of the buffet was wonderful and wide, covering local, western, asian foods etc. There's cooked dishes, soup, seafood, grilled items with a good spread of salad, fruits, pastries too. Generally, the foods were nice （though some were salty for me). The foods were also replenished regularly and service staff also cleared our used plates and utensils timely too.

Although you will need to pay for wine, softdrinks or hot beverages like coffee and western tea, fruit juices were included in the buffet such as mango juice, passion fruit juice, winter melon with jasmine juice. 

Do note that many visitors do come by here for their meal and it's free sitting. So be chope your tables promptly after entering or it can be taken by other incoming diners and take care of your belongings too as there were too many people walking around.

It's good for value meal as one get to taste so many cuisine!
